purpose: Independent dated government outlooks for context, not model inputs or historical accuracy scores.
comparability: The app forecasts real GDP at basic prices. Published government outlooks may use expenditure-based GDP at market prices and different information dates; differences are not forecast errors.
updatePolicy: Curated snapshots. Review new budget and quarterly economic documents before replacing values; preserve publication date and source hash.
